summary: Implemented SCH-07 recurring timers in backend scheduler flow. Added ISO 8601 repeat parser/decision logic (`R/PT...`, `Rn/PT...`), persisted recurrence state on timer rows, and re-armed recurring timers in the same DB transaction as firing. Finite repeat series terminate at N firings and infinite series continue until cancellation/termination. Added additive migration 016 for recurrence columns and constraints while preserving existing scheduler behavior.
